viewing_check: Weigh it (this decides the max, see per-gram table). Find the 9 / 9c / 375 mark on the clip, ring or a link. Check it is all one metal (clip sometimes base metal or plated). Check links are solid. Look at the break: one open link is a cheap repair and lets it sell as an albert chain rather than scrap.
